title: The names of exudyn.misc.symbolicSystem as Exudyn names them: ODE2RHS, ODE1RHS, ODE2ReactionForcesLHS, ODE1ReactionTermsLHS, ODE2Residual
author: Claude-JG
description: Keep the distinction of RHS and LHS forces of Exudyn, M a + LHS force = RHS force, to avoid sign issues; say ODE2 in the name of what is only for ODE2. As docs/dev/design/symbolicSystem.md section 12.5: Forces -> ODE2RHS, ODE1RightHandSide -> ODE1RHS, ReactionForces -> ODE2ReactionForcesLHS, the missing C_y^T z as ODE1ReactionTermsLHS, Residual -> ODE2Residual, ResidualJacobian -> ODE2ResidualJacobian, the results and arguments of Equations and GetFlatProgram, the arguments of NumpySystem.
releaseNotes: exudyn.misc.symbolicSystem names its equations as Exudyn does: ODE2RHS, ODE1RHS, ODE2ReactionForcesLHS, the new ODE1ReactionTermsLHS, ODE2Residual and ODE2ResidualJacobian; Equations and GetFlatProgram give 'ODE2RHS' and 'ODE2ReactionForcesLHS'; NumpySystem takes ode2RHS and ode1RHS.
